source: https://www.affinda.com/ (inline <svg class="sc-af-logo-mark" aria-label="Affinda"> in the footer, copied verbatim)
edits: #000000 (unset fill; the site paints it with currentColor) -> #14343B, Affinda's 'brand-inkwell' colour from the site CSS (--colour-brand-inkwell)
cropped the viewBox to the mark
notes: The site ships the mark as a standalone 'sc-af-logo-mark' SVG (footer), separate from the wordmark. Its fill is CSS currentColor, so I set the brand's own two colours: inkwell for light mode, mist-green for dark (the favicon's own pairing). No SVG of the tiled favicon exists (favicon.ico/apple-touch-icon PNG only).
license: Affinda brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Affinda.
